MINUTES
  SPECIAL MEETING: GLENDALE CITY COUNCIL POLICE COMMUNITY ROOM
  131 N Isabel St., First Floor, Room 100
  Glendale, CA 91206
  NOVEMBER 6, 2021 AT 9:00 AM

The Special Meeting of the Glendale City Council convened in the Council Chambers, in said City,
at 9:02 a.m. on the above date, pursuant to a call for such meeting signed by the City Clerk of
the City Council, and on file with the City Clerk, a copy of which is as follows:

  November 1, 2021
  Date

A SPECIAL PUBLIC MEETING of the City Council is hereby called to meet at 9:00 AM
on Saturday, November 6, 2021, in the Police Community Room, 131 N. Isabel St.,
Room 100, Glendale, CA 91206 to consider the following item(s) of business, to wit;

Governance and Priority Setting

•  Welcome and Call to Order
•  Comments from the City Manager
•  Review Today’s Agenda
•  Public Comment
•  Service and Teamwork
•  Highly Effective City Councils
•  Discussion of Roles
•  Current Council norms and City of Glendale Code of Conduct
•  Break for Lunch
•  City Manager’s Comments on Priority Setting
•  Review the Priority Setting Process
•  Discuss Individual Councilmember Priorities
•  Rank Council Priorities
•  Developing a Work Plan to Meet the Priorities
•  Wrap Up

Written Notice of said meeting was given, which Notice consisted of a copy of the
foregoing Call, and was served on each Member of the Council not joining in the Call,
and upon the in said City not less than 24 hours before the time fixed in said Call for said
meeting, as follows:
Upon Vrej Agajanian  at 5:00 p.m.  November 1, 2021  Glendale, CA
Upon Dan Brotman  at 5:00 p.m.  November 1, 2021  Glendale, CA
Upon Ardy Kassakhian  at 5:00 p.m.  November 1, 2021  Glendale, CA
Upon Ara Najarian  at 5:00 p.m.  November 1, 2021  Glendale, CA
Upon Paula Devine  at 5:00 p.m.  November 1, 2021  Glendale, CA
Mayor Devine called the meeting to order at 9:02 p.m.

  11 06 21
  SP CC  4A
   ROLL CALL
  - All Present
  - Report of the City Clerk of the City Council, re: Posting of Agenda. The
  Agenda for the Saturday, November 6, 2021 Special Public Meeting of the
  City Council was posted on November 1, 2021 on the Bulletin Board Outside
  City Hall.

Governance and Priority Setting

Rod Gould and Jennifer King of Management Partners opened the meeting and facilitated a
discussion with City Council on governance.

•  Welcome and Call to Order
•  Comments from the City Manager
•  Review Today’s Agenda
•  Public Comment
•  Service and Teamwork
•  Highly Effective City Councils
•  Discussion of Roles
•  Current Council norms and City of Glendale Code of Conduct
•  Break for Lunch – 12:10 p.m.
•  City Manager’s Comments on Priority Setting
•  Review the Priority Setting Process
•  Discuss Individual Councilmember Priorities
•  Rank Council Priorities
•  Developing a Work Plan to Meet the Priorities
•  Wrap Up

Members of the City Council developed a shared understanding of high-performance
governance best practices, discussed norms, established priorities for the next budget year, and
strengthened teamwork and leadership skills.

Staff will return to the City Council on December 7, 2021, to present a work plan containing
projects, programs, and initiatives to meet the Council’s top priorities over the next year. Staff
will ensure the work plan is consistent with budget, staffing, and workload constraints, and will
provide updates to Council on the progress of the priorities.

Adjournment – 1:57 p.m.
  Moved:  Najarian  Seconded:  Brotman

  Mayor of the City of Glendale

  City Clerk of the City of Glendale
